spec.title: Word Count CLI
spec.goal: Build a Rust command-line tool that counts the lines, words, and bytes of a text file given as its first argument, prints the three counts, and exits non-zero with a short usage message when the argument is missing.
acceptance: Running the binary with a file path prints line, word, and byte counts.
Running it without an argument prints a usage message and exits non-zero.
Unit tests cover the counting function.
constraints: Start from the reference template; keep its package metadata and lock file valid.
non_goals: No flags, recursion, or multiple files.
context: The reference template at `templates/bin/` is the starting point.
